 UPSC has declared the CDS I Final Result 2026, with 243 candidates qualifying for defence academy courses. Check the result, download steps and helpdesk details. 
 Sheetal Kumari 
 November 03, 2026 / 09:57 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026 UPSC announced CDS I Final Result 2026 with 243 qualifiers.
 Results are available for IMA, INA, and AFA courses.
 The recruitment drive aims to fill 451 total vacancies.

 The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has announced the Combined Defence Services (CDS) I Final Result 2026 , with 243 candidates qualifying for admission to various defence academy courses. Candidates who appeared for the written examination and subsequent Services Selection Board (SSB) interviews can check the result through the commission's official website, upsc.gov.in.
 The final selection list covers candidates recommended for admission to the 162nd (DE) Course at the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun, the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, Kerala, and the Air Force Academy (AFA), Hyderabad, for the Pre-Flying Training Course, also known as No. 221 F(P) Course.
 UPSC said the results of the medical examination have not been considered while preparing the merit lists. The announcement follows the written examination conducted on April 12, 2026, and the SSB interviews organised by the Services Selection Board of the Ministry of Defence.
 UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026: How to check
 Candidates who appeared for the written examination and interview can access the UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026 online. The result is available on the commission's official portal. They can follow these steps to check their qualifying status:
 Visit the official UPSC website, upsc.gov.in.
 Find and click on the link for the UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026 on the homepage.
 Open the result document on the new page.
 Check the roll numbers listed in the document to find out whether you have qualified.
 Download the result file and save a copy for future reference.
 Direct Link:  UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026

 Candidates should check the roll numbers carefully while viewing the result document. The commission has advised candidates to use its official website for further examination-related updates and information.
 UPSC CDS I 2026 exam: Written test dates and timings
 The CDS I written examination was held on April 12, 2026, in 3 shifts. The papers covered English, General Knowledge and Elementary Mathematics. The subject-wise examination schedule was as follows:
 Shift Timing Subject 
 First shift 9 am to 11 am English 
 Second shift 12.30 pm to 2.30 pm General Knowledge 
 Third shift 4 pm to 6 pm Elementary Mathematics 
 Candidates who cleared the written examination proceeded to the SSB interview stage. The interviews were conducted by the Services Selection Board under the Ministry of Defence as part of the selection process for the respective academy courses.
 UPSC CDS I Final Result 2026: Helpdesk and vacancy details
 Candidates seeking information or clarification about the examination can approach the UPSC Facilitation Counter on the commission's campus. The counter is open on working days between 10 am and 5.30 pm, where candidates can obtain assistance in person.
 Alternatively, candidates can contact the UPSC Candidate Helpdesk by telephone. The commission has provided the following contact details:
 Helpdesk details Information 
 First telephone number 011-24041001 
 Second telephone number 011-40303444 
 Telephone assistance timings 9 am to 8 pm 
 Availability All days 
 The CDS I 2026 recruitment drive is intended to fill 451 vacancies in the organisation. The application process began on December 11, 2025, and closed on December 30, 2025.
 Candidates are advised to visit upsc.gov.in for further details and official updates regarding the examination and selection process.
